description:
Persist knowledge across sessions and AI tools (Claude, GPT, Cursor, Codex, Gemini). The only cross-agent memory that survives session boundaries.

WHEN TO CALL:
• The moment an error or failure occurs → layer: "caveat" (auto-protected, never forgotten)
• When a decision is made or approved → content + anchor: {} (remembered AND enforced in one call)
• When a goal is set or updated → layer: "goal"
• When something new is learned → layer: "learning"
• When the user says "remember this" / "覚えておいて"
• After completing a task or receiving user approval

MODES:
• Create (default): content is the only required field. entity defaults to the project you are in; layer defaults to "context" (or "learning" when anchor is set).
• Create + enforce: add anchor: {} — the memory also becomes a decision the guard re-injects before Edit/Write/Bash and on session start. Give anchor.violation_signal (forbidden strings) to make contradictions detectable; anchor.affects (path globs) to scope it.
• Update: memory_id (+ optional content, layer, importance). content replaces the stored content; add merge: true to change only the JSON keys you send (the other keys are kept, a key sent as null is removed)
• Delete: memory_id + forget: true

Importance ≥ 0.9 pins the memory (protected from auto-forgetting). Supports Japanese (日本語) and English.

anchor.description: Also declare this as an enforceable decision. Pass {} for defaults, or an object: { kind?: "decision"|"prohibition"|"constraint", violation_signal?: string[] (forbidden strings — needed for the gate to detect a contradiction), affects?: string[] (path globs that scope it), detect_terms?: string[], domain?: string, rationale?: string }. Without violation_signal the anchor is a constraint: re-injected on session start and when its scope is touched, but no contradiction can be detected.

content.description: The memory content (plain text or structured JSON with altitude/type/state/what/why). The only required field for create.

entity_key.description: Optional canonical key (email, domain, file path)

entity_name.description: What this memory is about. Optional — defaults to the project you are working in (from workspace roots, else the files edited recently).

force.description: Bypass the paste-back quality check and the broken-JSON check: content that starts like JSON but does not parse is then stored as text.

forget.description: Set true + memory_id to delete a memory. Caveat-layer and pinned memories cannot be deleted.

layer.description: One of: goal / context / emotion / implementation / caveat / learning. Aliases accepted (why→goal, warnings→caveat, decisions→learning, how→implementation). Optional — defaults to "context", or "learning" when anchor is set.

memory_id.description: Set to update an existing memory instead of creating. Only content/layer/importance are changed.

merge.description: Update mode only (with memory_id): merge the keys of content (a JSON object) into the stored JSON object instead of replacing it. Keys you send win; a key sent as null is removed — except the provenance keys (title, evidence_refs, session_id, restored_from, original_id, original_created_at, restored_verdict, supersedes, superseded_by, consolidated_into, distilled, altitude, type, state), where null refuses the merge; every other stored key (title, affects, evidence_refs, session_id, …) is kept. Refused, and nothing is written, when the stored content or the new content is not a JSON object. Without merge, content replaces the whole stored content.

supersedes.description: Create mode only: the memory id(s) this new memory replaces (a reversed or updated decision). Writes a supersedes link and marks the old memory superseded; recall then hides it unless include_superseded is true. Refused — and nothing is saved — if an id does not exist, belongs to another entity, or is a raw session capture — and when content is JSON missing any of altitude/type/state (send plain text or all three).

thread_id.description: Optional thread ID to group related memories (decision chains, session groups).

name: remember
